api-answers:
&api-questions;
The NetBeansFX Layout API provides stable identities and immutable values for product-owned logical areas (ViewArea), physical dock groups (DockGroupSpec) and content-free layout trees (LayoutSpec/LayoutNode) built with LayoutBuilder, read from secure standard XML with LayoutXml, or declared with LayoutRegistration or ViewAreaRegistration and discovered through LayoutRegistry, including caller-resolved includes, presentations, capacities, capabilities, policy references, styling and lifecycle.
Ids are immutable, namespaced and persistable. Built-in roles/kinds are neutral; products define their own namespaced values. XML parsing disables DTDs, external entities and external resources. The module contains no JavaFX or shell-rendering behavior. Runtime code is limited to stateless XML parsing, layout discovery and logical-area metadata discovery.
Author a product-owned layout programmatically, as standard XML or as a source annotation.
Generate self-contained NbFx/Layouts resources and neutral NbFx/LayoutAreas metadata, and discover both without instantiating declaration classes.
Validate areas, groups, references and split geometry before rendering.
Round-trip layout identity, policy references, styling and metadata without JavaFX or content instances.
Unit tests cover id parsing, immutable model validation, builder behavior, XML equality, deterministic output, inherited defaults, caller-resolved includes, exact path diagnostics, unsafe XML rejection, annotation-generated layer resources, bundle-key validation, duplicate-id diagnostics, UTF-8 canonicalization, area metadata reconstruction and registry discovery.
A JDK is required only to compile.
Only org.netbeans.api.nbfx.layout is public.
The Java annotation processors are discovered at compile time through META-INF/services/javax.annotation.processing.Processor. Runtime layout and area discovery read the configuration layer directly and do not use Lookup.
@ServiceProvider(service = Processor.class) registers LayoutRegistrationProcessor and ViewAreaRegistrationProcessor at compile time.
LayoutRegistration writes self-contained NbFx/Layouts/<id>.xml resources. ViewAreaRegistration writes neutral NbFx/LayoutAreas/<role> metadata folders.
LayoutXml reads caller-provided XML and explicit include-resolver streams. LayoutRegistry reads generated layer XML resources and area metadata; neither performs implicit filesystem or network access.
None.
XML readers/writers and the registry are stateless. Builders are local mutable operations and are not thread-safe. Annotation processing happens at compile time. None of these APIs has runtime thread affinity.
No code runs at startup.
No code runs on exit.
No special requirements.
